settings.text: Two national brands, four team hubs and more than thirty shows a week. Hockey is where the network started and where most of it still lives.
The ultimate destination for NHL enthusiasts: up-to-the-minute breaking news, expert insights and thought-provoking opinions.

settings.heading: Breaking news, lineups and fantasy
settings.body: A website dedicated to giving NHL fans breaking news, lineup information, player updates, fantasy hockey resources and in-depth analysis. Whether you are a dedicated NHL fan or a passionate fantasy hockey player, dailyfaceoff.com is the go-to destination.

settings.heading: Daily Faceoff Live
settings.body: This show digs into the latest news, analysis and storylines from the world of professional hockey. Each episode features expert guests, player interviews and in-depth conversations covering everything from game previews and recaps to player performances and trade rumours.

settings.heading: DFO Rundown
settings.body: A weekly dose of insightful analysis, spirited discussion and humorous banter. From game highlights and standout performances to trade rumours and playoff predictions, the DFO Rundown covers it all with a blend of expertise and entertainment.

settings.heading: DFO Fantasy Podcast
settings.body: Brock Seguin and a team of experienced fantasy hockey enthusiasts bring insights, analysis and strategies to help you dominate your league. Whether you are a seasoned fantasy player looking for an edge or a beginner learning the ropes, the DFO Fantasy podcast has you covered.

settings.eyebrow: With Jonny Lazarus and Colby Cohen
settings.heading: Morning Cuppa Hockey
settings.body: Jonny Lazarus and Colby Cohen know their hockey, but they do not always agree on it. Having played at multiple levels -- and won a Stanley Cup between them -- they spend each morning on the latest news, trends and controversial plays, and introduce you to some interesting characters from around the game.

settings.text: The ultimate destination for fans who crave the intense and gritty side of the game.

settings.heading: Every drop of the gloves, catalogued
settings.body: Hockey Fights offers a comprehensive collection of videos, statistics and analysis from various leagues and eras. From jaw-dropping knockouts to epic battles between rival teams, the site captures and catalogues the most memorable moments in hockey fighting history, alongside player profiles, historical data and a passionate community of like-minded fans.

settings.text: Team-focused hubs for the Oilers, Flames, Canucks and Leafs: fan communities driven by a passion for one team, blending news, opinion, statistics and entertainment.

settings.heading: Fan first websites
settings.body:
Our collection of NHL, MLB and NBA team-focused websites offers thought-provoking and insightful perspectives on the teams fans follow. Authored by knowledgeable writers and passionate fans, the sites carry in-depth analysis, opinion, player evaluations and game reviews, and give fans somewhere to argue about all of it.

Four of those sites cover hockey:

  • OilersNation for the Edmonton Oilers
  • FlamesNation for the Calgary Flames
  • CanucksArmy for the Vancouver Canucks
  • TheLeafsNation for the Toronto Maple Leafs

settings.heading: Social media
settings.body: With a vibrant online presence, the Nation social accounts give fans timely updates, engaging content, humorous banter and interactive discussion. From breaking news and highlights to behind-the-scenes glimpses, the channels keep fans connected and informed.
